places.name: Garden City Hotels
places.description: Garden City Hotel is a full-service hospitality destination. It offers smart, elegant rooms, an on-site restaurant (Kiri Restaurant) featuring a popular Sunday buffet, a swimming pool, a fitness center, a spa, a lounge, and pick-up/drop-off services

location.address: No. 312 Woji Road, GRA

testimonials.comment: The hotel is exquisite, has a good environment, safe, serene. Garden City gives you value for your money. I enjoyed their meal, their rooms are super comfortable with a king-size bed with well befitting ecstatics

I enjoyed their buffet. I heard about the hotel and called them. Their response was good. The staff was friendly and answered my questions. The hotel usually has a buffet in the morning everyday and on Sunday afternoons. They have a variety of foods, snacks, vegetables and soups. I was impressed by the food. Their food tasted really good. I ate all their continental dish. Next was their soup which I ate their seafood okro. It was delicious. I couldn't eat the affang soup due to lack of space in my belly.

places.name: Gordonsville Escape Boutique Hotel & Spa
places.description: Gordonsville Escape Boutique Hotel & Spa is a 20-room, exclusive, award-winning luxury boutique hotel set on acres of lush gardens in the heart of Port Harcourt. It offers an intimate and luxurious retreat for discerning travelers.

location.address: Bozgomero Estate, 30 Abuloma Rd, opposite FCMB Bank, Trans Amadi

images: /project/locations/Gordonsville Escape Boutique Hotel & Spa/Gordonsville Escape Boutique Hotel & Spa.jpeg

testimonials.comment: I stayed here 12 days, and it is really a nice boutique hotel. Several gates, very safe. The cleaning crew came in every day when I allowed them to. I gave it 4 stars because they give you one pack of tea with two small sugars a day. I do not drink coffee, but two small sugars is ridiculously to me. I asked for more, and they said I only get two a day. I like two sugars in one cup of tea, but sometimes I like two or three cups of hot tea when I’m in hotels a day.

The rooms and the environment is top notch. The service is sub par, the staff act like they're doing this against their will (are they?). The rooms are not sound proof so the smallest excited conversation and you're told to keep it down like in primary school.

This is such a beautiful place and the customer service was beyond remarkable. It is in a quiet and serene environment, there is no unnecessary noise, the food tastes great, the poolside is beautiful, the AC is working perfectly. I wish I could stay longer I really enjoyed my stay here I will definitely recommend it to my friends.

location.address: Eastern Bypass, Ogbunabali, Amadi 500101

images: /project/locations/Heliconia Park Port Harcourt Hote/Heliconia Park Port Harcourt Hotel.jpeg

testimonials.comment: Had a wonderful stay at Heliconia with my wife. We enjoyed every bit of the two weeks we spent there. Peaceful, calm, and very cozy atmosphere. The buffet breakfast was lovely, the amenities were pleasant, and the overall experience was excellent. Highly recommend for a relaxing staycation.

Heliconia hotel is a great experience, I am enjoying every bit of my stay. I am a frequent visitor to Port Harcourt and had planned a 2days stay at this hotel but I am staying extra 4 days because I truly enjoy staying at this hotel, the …

The hotel is clean. Highly organised with full security. The services are great. Fully functional facilities. The rooms are lovely,functional and clean. Fully air conditioned. It was a great experience. You will look forward to be there again
